website.discard_confirm: Throw away all unpublished changes and go back to the published version?
website.publish_confirm_update: Publish the changes now? Patients see them right away.
website.publish_confirm_first: Publish the new website now? It replaces the standard clinic page.

website.list_help: Leave an item empty to remove it.

live_data.doctors: Doctor details (photo, specialty, fee) come straight from the Doctors page.
live_data.services: Services and prices come straight from the Services page.
live_data.reviews: Only verified reviews are shown, updated automatically.
live_data.insurance: Active insurance companies from Clinical setup are shown.
live_data.contact: Address, phone and e-mail come from the clinic profile.
live_data.hours: Opening days and hours come from the clinic profile.

website.remove_confirm: Remove the "{name}" section from the draft?
website.discarded: The draft is back to the published version.
website.need_address: Choose the clinic page address first.
website.unpublished_ok: The website is taken down. A short page for booking and contact stays up.
website.restored_ok: The older version was copied into the draft. Review it, then publish.
website.theme_lead: Template, theme and brand change the look only; the content stays as it is.
website.themes_sub: How it is presented: spacing, corners, hero and heading weight.

theme_desc.bold: Hero in the clinic colour, strong headings

website.brand_kit_sub: Logo, colours and font — every theme uses them.

brand.primary_help: Buttons and links. Contrast is checked automatically.
brand.font_help: Fonts already on visitors' devices; nothing loaded from other servers.
brand.motion_help: Sections appear as visitors scroll and cards lift slightly. Never shown to visitors who ask for reduced motion.
brand.logo_dark_help: A light (e.g. white) version of the logo shown when the site is dark. Optional.

website.templates_sub: A starting point by specialty: a fitting section order and theme.
website.template_confirm: Apply the template? The design changes; the content stays.
website.template_add_missing: Add the template's sections the page does not have
website.settings_lead: The clinic page address, whether the site is up, and earlier versions.
website.publishing_sub: Taking the site down does not stop booking: a short page stays up.
website.down_explain: The site is taken down. Reminder links and printed QR codes still work and open a short booking page.
website.up_explain: The website is visible to patients.
website.unpublish_confirm: Take the website down? Patients see a short page with name, contact and the booking button only.
website.versions_sub: The last 10. Restoring copies into the draft; it never publishes by itself.
website.no_versions: Nothing published from the builder yet.
website.restore_confirm: Copy this version into the draft? The current draft is replaced.
website.booking_lead: Online booking, online consultations and booking links.
website.domain_lead: Show your website at your own address, like www.yourclinic.com.
website.domain_enter_sub: Type the address patients will type.
website.domain_host_help: Like www.yourclinic.com or book.yourclinic.com. You can connect the other form (with or without www) after it is verified.
website.owner_sub: Add this record at your domain provider to prove you own it.
website.dns_sub: Point the domain to the platform with one of these records.
website.ssl_sub: The hosting issues the HTTPS certificate automatically; here we only check it.

ssl_text.unknown: Check the certificate once the domain is verified.
ssl_text.pending: The hosting has not issued a certificate for this domain yet. It usually takes up to 24 hours.
ssl_text.active: The connection is secure. The certificate is valid until {date}.
ssl_text.expiring: The certificate expires on {date}. It usually renews by itself.
ssl_text.failed: The certificate is not valid for this domain. Check the hosting settings.

ssl_msg.pending: The certificate is not issued yet.

website.alias_sub: Connect {other} so visitors are sent to {main}.
website.alias_saved: The other address was added. Add its records, then check.
website.alias_live: The other address works and redirects to the main one.
website.domain_help_side: Your website and booking work on this domain once verified. Staff sign-in stays on the platform address.
website.email_lead: Send patient e-mails from your clinic's address instead of the platform's.
website.email_account_note: Account e-mails (sign-up, password reset, invitations) always come from the platform address.
website.email_not_in_package_now: Clinic e-mail is not in the current package; e-mails go out from the platform address.
website.email_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect the clinic e-mail? E-mails will go out from the platform address.
website.email_none_text: No address connected yet. E-mails go out from the platform address with the clinic's address to reply to.
website.email_connect_sub: Choose your mail provider. The password is stored encrypted and never shown again.
website.email_oauth_unavailable: Connecting with Google or Microsoft must be enabled by the platform administrator. SMTP works with any provider.

smtp.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
smtp.password_help: The account password or an app password.

website.email_uses_title: What goes out from the clinic address
website.email_uses_sub: Choose which e-mails use your address.

mail_kind_help.patient_letters: Letters and reports sent to the patient.

website.email_always_platform: Account and security e-mails always come from the platform.
website.email_dns_sub: DNS records help your e-mails arrive and stay out of spam.
website.spf_missing: No SPF record for {domain}. Add the one your mail provider gives you.
website.dkim_missing: No DKIM key with this selector.
website.dns_explain: Your domain provider adds these records following your mail provider's instructions. {brand} only checks them.
website.email_saved: Account saved. Test the connection now.
website.email_test_ok: Connected and signed in to the server.
website.email_test_body: This is a test e-mail from {clinic}. If it arrived, the setup works.
website.email_sent_to: A test e-mail was sent to {to}.
website.seo_lead: How your site appears in search results and when its link is shared.
website.seo_title_help: Up to 70 characters. The clinic name is used when empty.
website.seo_description_help: Up to 160 characters. The intro text is used when empty.
website.seo_image_help: Shown when the link is shared on WhatsApp and social media.
website.seo_hide: Hide the site from search engines
website.seo_hide_help: The site stays available to anyone with the link.
website.seo_advanced_locked: The share image and hiding the site are advanced settings not included in your package.
website.goes_live_on_publish: Goes live with the next publish.
website.seo_auto: Clinic, doctor and review data are added automatically in a format search engines understand, and the sitemap updates itself.
website.stat_book_hint: People who opened the booking form
website.views_per_day_sub: Clinic page, doctor pages and booking page together.
website.no_online_bookings: No online bookings in this period.
website.analytics_privacy: Visits are counted inside {brand} without cookies or personal data. Staff and search-engine visits are not counted.

domain_issue.dns: The domain {host} no longer points to the platform
domain_issue.txt: The ownership record of {host} is missing
domain_issue.ssl: The HTTPS certificate of {host} is not valid
domain_issue.ssl_soon: The HTTPS certificate of {host} expires soon

website.go_online_text: Pick a template and your brand, check doctors and services, then publish. Connect your domain and clinic e-mail later.
website.go_online_down: The clinic website is taken down. The short booking page works.

sec_desc.hero: The first thing visitors see: name and booking button.
sec_desc.about: A few words about the clinic.
sec_desc.doctors: The clinic's doctors, from its records.
sec_desc.services: Services and prices, from the records.
sec_desc.booking_cta: A band inviting visitors to book.
sec_desc.cards: Cards with pictures or icons and buttons.
sec_desc.image_text: A picture beside text and a button.
sec_desc.stats: Highlighted numbers, e.g. years of experience.
sec_desc.divider: A wave, curve or line between sections.
sec_desc.images: Pictures side by side: two, three or four per row, with a caption under each.
sec_desc.columns: Content in two, three or four columns: a picture or icon, title, text and button.
sec_desc.partners: Logos of partners, insurers and labs — a sliding row or a grid.
sec_desc.team: Photo cards of your doctors or team that move on hover: lift, flip, reveal the details, or round photos with a turning ring.
sec_desc.before_after: Two pictures on top of each other and a line the visitor drags to compare — or side by side.
sec_desc.testimonials: Patients’ words you write, with a photo and stars: cards, one big rotating quote, or speech bubbles.
sec_desc.tabs: Titles to click; each shows its own text, picture and button.
sec_desc.video: A YouTube or Vimeo video, full width or next to text.
sec_desc.marquee: Short phrases scrolling across the page (services, slogans).
sec_desc.map: A Google map for each branch with its address and a directions button.
sec_desc.instagram: Your latest Instagram posts automatically, or posts you choose.

style.shapes_help: Shapes show on a section with a coloured or picture background.
style.anim_help: Works when site motion is on in Theme & brand; never shown to visitors who ask their device for reduced motion.

b.pick_hint: Click any section in the preview or in the list to edit it.
b.on_page_open: On the page — click to open it

empty_hint.tabs: Add a tab with a title.
empty_hint.video: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link.
empty_hint.map: Add a place: its Google Maps name or coordinates.

b.header_desc: Logo, links and buttons at the top of every page.
b.footer_desc: At the bottom of every page: about, contact, links, social profiles.
b.home_settings_hint: The home page's search title and description are under Search engines.
b.page_address_help: Lower-case English letters, numbers and dashes.
b.page_remove_confirm: Remove the page “{name}” and all its sections from the draft?
b.h_sticky: Stays at the top while scrolling
b.h_name: Show the clinic name beside the logo
b.menu_auto_help: Without links, the pages marked “in the menu” show automatically.
b.link_label_ph: The page or section name is used
b.f_powered_help: Hiding this line depends on the clinic's package.
b.social_help: https links to the clinic's own pages on these sites only.
b.logo_height_help: Drag to set the height in pixels (0 = follow the size choice). The logo always keeps its own shape and proportions.
b.carousel_help: “Follow the language”: in Arabic the items travel right, in English left. The row pauses on hover or touch.
b.url_help: YouTube (regular, shorts, youtu.be) and Vimeo links only. Shown in the privacy-friendly player.
b.page_link_help: Used when the action is "Open a page of the site".
b.f_contact_extra_help: For example another branch's address and phone. Each line shows as you write it.

website.seo_keywords_help: Words patients search with, separated by commas. Used in the description AI assistants read.
website.geo_lead: So the clinic shows in "near me" results and on maps.
website.geo_help: In Google Maps: long-press the clinic and copy the two numbers.
website.aio_lead: How ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity describe the clinic when patients ask them.
website.aio_summary_ph: Who you are, what you are known for, who your care suits, how patients book…
website.aio_summary_help: Real facts only. Published with the clinic's data (doctors, services, prices, hours, FAQ) in llms.txt.
website.aio_bots: Let AI assistants read the site
website.aio_bots_help: Blocking asks GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others not to read the clinic's pages. Regular search engines are not affected.

chk_fix.title: Add it above.
chk_fix.description: Add it above or in the clinic's settings.
chk_fix.faq: Add a Frequent questions section in the builder — it shows as Q&A in search results.

typo.title: Fonts and colours
typo.low_contrast: Contrast on white is {ratio}:1 — below 4.5:1, it may be hard to read.
typo.colors_help: Colours are for the light look. In dark mode the site's own colours keep text readable, and coloured sections keep theirs.
typo.fonts_sub: Upload your brand fonts (woff2, woff, ttf or otf) and choose them for text or headings above.
typo.file_help: Up to 2 MB. woff2 is best.
typo.family_help: Upload the weights of one font (regular, bold) under the same name so the site uses each in its place.
typo.remove_confirm: Remove the font “{name}”? Text using it goes back to the default font.
typo.license: Only upload fonts you are licensed to use on a website.

website.prices_sub: Show or hide prices for the whole clinic.
website.prices_site_text: Doctors' fees and service prices on the website pages and in search results.
website.prices_booking: Show prices on the booking page
website.prices_booking_text: The fee and the service price while choosing a doctor and service.
website.prices_note: When on, each doctor's and service's own choice (show or hide its price) still applies. A prepaid online consultation always shows its fee.

dark.title: Dark mode for the website
dark.sub: Can visitors use your website in dark mode?
dark.on_text: The site follows the visitor's device, with a button to switch between light and dark.
dark.off_text: The site is always light and the switch is hidden.
dark.switch_help: Applies to the live site straight away. When off, the site and its booking pages are always light and the switch is hidden.
dark.saved: Dark mode saved and applied to the live site straight away.

website.mail_host_fixed: The server name "{from}" does not exist, so "{to}" is used instead. Press "Test connection" to check.

mail_err.host: The mail server "{host}" does not exist. Copy it exactly as your hosting panel shows under "Outgoing Server" (e.g. doc.example.com, without mail.).
mail_err.auth: The server refused the user name or password. Use the full e-mail address as the user name and that mailbox's password.
mail_err.conn: The server could not be reached on this port. Try 465 (SSL) or 587 (STARTTLS).
mail_err.tls: The security certificate does not match the server name. Use the name shown in the certificate (often the hosting server's name).

import.title: Import site content
import.lead: Upload the prepared content file (zip): the website pages are created, the pictures added and the doctors' profiles filled in. Everything stays editable.
import.upload_sub: A .zip holding content.json and the pictures.
import.opt_site: Website pages (written to the draft — the live site does not change until you publish)
import.opt_doctors: Update the existing doctors (description, education, profile, social profiles)
import.opt_create: Add the doctors that are missing
import.opt_photos: Replace the doctors' photos with the file's
import.no_doctors_perm: Updating doctors needs the permission to manage doctors.
import.warn: The draft's pages are replaced by the file's. The current draft is kept as a version you can restore from Website settings → Versions.
import.confirm: Import the content and replace the draft's pages?
import.done: Content imported. Review the draft, then publish.
import.result_sub: The content is in the draft — nothing is published yet.
import.r_media: Pictures added to the media library: {n}
import.next: Open the builder to review the pages and change any text or picture, then press "Publish".
import.opt_services: Add the main services and sub-services to the system (booking and invoices — you set the prices)

help.query: The place name as on Google Maps (e.g. Abdali Hospital Amman) or coordinates such as 31.9655,35.9001.
help.map_query: Leave empty to use the clinic address, or write the Google Maps place name or coordinates.
help.username: Without @ — e.g. mqdentalcenter. The account must be public.
help.link: A link starting with https://, tel: or mailto: — used when the button action is "Custom link".
help.url: An Instagram post or reel link, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/p/…
